They want fallback: when confidence low, create a draft ticket flagged for human review (instead of auto-publish).
Legal asked: can we redact PII in logs and provide retention TTL? — flagged as blocker.
Notes: interested in streaming responses for live agent assist UI; wants tool-calling to hit their ticket-create API (OAuth).
Potential upsell later: Dedicated if growth demands guaranteed throughput and residency controls.
AE/Jordan: rapid follow-up promised; Maya to run technical POC with 2 example workflows.
